title: Portable Web Toolkit — machine setup
subtitle: Prepares your computer for Astro + Cloudflare development with AI coding agents.
adminNote: Installing missing tools may require administrator (Windows) or sudo (macOS/Linux). You choose what to install before anything runs.

required.name: Core host tools
required.description: Git, Node.js 26+ (current line), pyenv-native, Python 3.14+ workspace venv (3.13+ minimum), and pip

optional.name: pnpm
optional.description: Fast Node package manager (optional; npm is included with Node)

optional.name: Bun
optional.description: Alternative JavaScript runtime and package manager

optional.name: uv
optional.description: Fast Python package installer (complements pyenv-native venvs)

optional.name: GitHub CLI
optional.description: GitHub from the terminal (repos, PRs, auth)

optional.name: .NET SDK
optional.description: Only if you work on .NET projects alongside web sites

optional.name: Python Playwright + Chromium
optional.description: Browser automation inside your project Python venv (for AI agent browser tools)

workspace.name: Project folder checks
workspace.description: Verify README, package.json, Astro config, and related files in the target workspace

pyenvNativeBlurb: pyenv-native is a Rust rewrite of pyenv — the recommended Python version manager on Windows, macOS, and Linux. It installs runtimes and per-project virtual environments without conflicting with system Python.
